title: LLaCO: Continuous Diffusion for Large Language Models with Competition-Aware Semantic Scheduling
abstract: arXiv:2610.32604v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continuous diffusion models have emerged as a promising non-autoregressive paradigm for text generation over continuous embedding spaces. Along the continuous trajectory, the residual token identity directly shapes the denoising objective. However, the geometric trajectory misaligns with temporal progression, triggering severe temporal compression. In this paper, we show that embedding norm decay causes Euclidean distance to yield spurious overtaking, indicating that token competition must be evaluated directionally. In this space, a candidate overtakes the source token only when the effective noise magnitude surpasses their semantic separation. We formalize these pairwise dynamics as the Competition Threshold Theory (CTT). Crucially, high-dimensional overtaking requires extreme noise levels, causing standard trajectories to concentrate identity decay into a narrow window near the noisy endpoint. To resolve this, we propose Semantic Rete

translated_title: LLaCO：面向大语言模型的连续扩散模型与竞争感知语义调度
translated_abstract: 连续扩散模型已成为一种在连续嵌入空间上进行文本生成的有前景的非自回归范式。在连续轨迹上，残差词元身份直接塑造了去噪目标。然而，几何轨迹与时间进程并不对齐，引发了严重的时间压缩问题。在本文中，我们证明了嵌入范数的衰减会导致欧氏距离产生虚假的超越现象，这表明词元竞争必须从方向性角度进行评估。在该空间中，只有当有效噪声幅度超过候选词元与源词元之间的语义间隔时，候选词元才会超越源词元。我们将这些成对动态形式化为竞争阈值理论。至关重要的是，高维空间中的超越需要极端的噪声水平，导致标准轨迹将身份衰减集中到接近噪声端点的狭窄窗口内。为解决这一问题，我们提出了语义重新……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出竞争阈值理论来揭示连续扩散语言模型中词元超越的动态机制，并据此提出竞争感知的语义调度方法，以解决轨迹与时间不对齐导致的时间压缩问题。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes token overtaking dynamics in continuous diffusion language models as Competition Threshold Theory (CTT) and proposes competition-aware semantic scheduling to resolve temporal compression caused by trajectory-temporal misalignment.
